title: Why a Higher Income Can Still Leave You Financially Stuck

book_reference.title: The Psychology of Money
book_reference.author: Morgan Housel
book_reference.edition_or_url: Conceptual reference only; verify edition and specific idea attribution before publication

scenes.visual: Open book with a dramatic push-in.
scenes.text_en: Your income can rise while your wealth stays still.
scenes.translation_ar: (ممكن دخلك يزيد، لكن ثروتك تفضل مكانها.)

scenes.visual: A page turn reveals a payday calendar.
scenes.text_en: The missing piece is what happens after payday.
scenes.translation_ar: (السؤال المهم: بيحصل إيه بعد يوم القبض؟)

scenes.visual: Income and obligations appear on opposite pages.
scenes.text_en: More income does not automatically mean more freedom.
scenes.translation_ar: (الدخل الأعلى مش معناه تلقائيًا حرية مالية أكبر.)

scenes.visual: Highlight two lines moving closer together.
scenes.text_en: When spending expands with income, the gap disappears.
scenes.translation_ar: (لما المصاريف تكبر مع الدخل، الفرق بيختفي.)

scenes.visual: The blank space becomes a savings jar.
scenes.text_en: That gap is where saving and investing begin.

scenes.visual: Two open pages represent two people.
scenes.text_en: Imagine two people earning the same amount.
scenes.source_note: Hypothetical example, not real people or data.

scenes.visual: Shopping icons accumulate beside the first page.
scenes.text_en: One upgrades every expense after each raise.

scenes.visual: Coins move from a spending column into savings.
scenes.text_en: The other saves part of every increase.

scenes.visual: Two paths branch toward different future pages.
scenes.text_en: Their pay is equal; their future options are not.

scenes.visual: A clean three-number ledger opens on the desk.
scenes.text_en: Start by tracking only three numbers each month.

scenes.visual: Highlight the income line in the ledger.
scenes.text_en: Your take-home income after deductions.

scenes.visual: Recurring expense lines slide onto the page.
scenes.text_en: Your essential costs and recurring commitments.

scenes.visual: A calculator reveals the amount remaining.
scenes.text_en: The amount left before optional spending.

scenes.visual: A page divides needs from wants.
scenes.text_en: Do not confuse every expense with a bad decision.
scenes.translation_ar: (مش كل مصروف زيادة يبقى قرار غلط.)

scenes.visual: One meaningful purchase receives a gold underline.
scenes.text_en: Spend on what matters, but choose it consciously.
scenes.translation_ar: (اصرف على اللي يهمك، بس باختيار واعي.)

scenes.visual: A scheduled transfer arrow moves toward a savings jar.
scenes.text_en: Automate a realistic saving amount on payday.
scenes.translation_ar: (خلّي مبلغ ادخار واقعي يتحول أول ما تقبض.)

scenes.visual: A protective shield appears beside the ledger.
scenes.text_en: Build a safety buffer before chasing high returns.
scenes.translation_ar: (كوّن احتياطي أمان قبل مطاردة العوائد العالية.)
scenes.source_note: General educational guidance, not a personal recommendation.

scenes.visual: The book pages close slowly around the key takeaway.
scenes.text_en: A raise is an opportunity, not a spending instruction.
scenes.translation_ar: (الزيادة فرصة، مش أمر إنك تصرف أكتر.)

scenes.visual: A gold line connects savings to a future page.
scenes.text_en: Protect the gap; give your future more choices.

scenes.visual: Close the book and reveal a save prompt.
scenes.text_en: Save this lesson and review your numbers this week.
